name: Open Model Release Receipt
capability: Produces a bounded release receipt for local or HTTP model artifacts without claiming training quality, loader-side-effect safety, or production deployment.
next_gap: Keep buyer acceptance, loader side effects, and production deployment unclaimed until separately measured.
boundaries: exactly eight artifacts and at most 10 MiB
manifest-declared loader exit is asserted; loader filesystem, network, database, training, and publication side effects are outside receipt assurance
